items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Ben eventually arrived and we did some original numbers and one that I composed in the studio

ctx.x: I arrived at the studio that morning and learned that Buck had been taken to a hospital the night before, suffering from a nose haemorrhage. The rhythm section was from the Alex Welsch orchestra and Jack Higgins was in charge of the date.

As I was the first soloist to arrive and we three were supposed to record a few tunes alone and play some that had been arranged by Buck, I got started with the Rhythm section and had gotten three in the bag before Ben arrived. He was supposed to have come to the studio with Buck and didn't know that Buck had been taken to a hospital. Jack had to call Ben and tell him to take a taxi to the studio.

Ben eventually arrived and we did some original numbers and one that I composed in the studio and called it "Pound Horn", because I had learned that studio trumpettists that doubled on flugel horn were paid an extra pound when the horn was used at a session and English musicians called it a pound horn.
